title: Seven-window radix-37 X tables: charged memory for less lookup work

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh coins. An independent 64-bit run gate opens iff u < K, K = 7204436109379059621, the least integer with (K/2^64) lo_run >= 0.39; the exact opened-run bound lo_run >= 0.9985833838 is recomputed from success.md. Expected total work is at most 2^123.611690137226200 target-group-operation equivalents at C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions/unit, E=2^7+(K/2^64)E_run, with at most 81.5110 E-averaged instructions per full-run leaf. The disclosed per-run worst case is 2^190.446049 instructions. Peak memory is at most 2^135.9802 bytes and charged preprocessing at most 2^118.2983 units; no advice. Machine premises (2^72 nodes, finite apertures, LS64 and 256-byte DC ZVA) are in proof.md 2.1. q1=536870720 batches, q2=2^25 incidences, six leaves/incidence, 8192x4 Y geometry, 320 groups, epoch-cursor index recovery and history-conditional PHI accounting are retained from epoch29 (95cf6938). This revision stores X coefficient tables in base 2^37: seven used windows instead of eight base-2^32 windows, while constructing and charging all eight slots in each of 2^37 rows of each of 5120 2^45-byte tables. PFWD=146 and BWDP=2220 save exactly 32 instructions/incidence; construction is 92+96*2^37 per table, included in full. cap_p=2^22-2^17 and R1's actual reservation through the packed next-array end permit the tables within the 64-bit address space; all success prefixes, PHI weights, gate and ledger rows are recomputed. The weak representatives may differ; every underlying field value is congruent and the inherited conservative site, fixup and label bounds apply. certificate.py checks declarations with exact Fractions; wolfram.md records independent arithmetic. Experiments cover production-field kernels and small routing machines. Sources/limitations are in proof.md 9; no prior verdict is a premise. No new heuristic or production break is claimed.

experiments.purpose: Seven-window radix-37 production-field fwd/bwd/keys and Y-record models, 302 digit/lookup cases including weak operands and limb crossings, tbld8 construction, arithmetic sites and fixups; inherited routing/join/epoch and ISA checks; counts matched to certificate.py. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums; not a production-scale attack.
